clauses.reason: Separate maintainer principles from user work and keep one implementation authority.

scope: Consumer documentation, local tools and downstream adoption
updates.statement: Internal development principles belong in maintainer policy; user entrypoints explain outcomes, installation and tasks.

updates.rationale: Installation alone cannot authorize repository policy changes, and manual runtime assembly is avoidable friction.
scope: Consumer documentation, local tools and downstream adoption
updates.statement: Adoption is an explicit reviewed local change with inspect, source-bound preview and guarded application; preserve existing application runners and use one runtime owner.

updates.rationale: Ergonomics must not weaken approval or hide effective history.
scope: Consumer documentation, local tools and downstream adoption
updates.statement: Tools bind routine journal operations to the current approved workspace; current discovery also exposes retained historical sources until separately reviewed migration replaces their authority.

updates.rationale: A one-way extraction does not validate the product in real downstream development.
scope: Consumer documentation, local tools and downstream adoption
updates.statement: Perdura is both an experience source and an intended real consumer using the ordinary adoption path; remove downstream duplicate tools only after actual replacement evidence.

decisions.reason: The owner approved the consumer-focused repair plan and authorized the changes in this repository, including readiness for actual Perdura adoption.

revision.summary: Low-friction adoption and use without weakening repository authority.

transaction.reason: Apply the exact owner-approved consumer boundary decision before implementation.
